## B: HIDDEN bridges (5B, decision 5)

Binary-only break: a recompile against 1.0 needs no source change. *Added in* is the PR of the `@Deprecated` line (git blame). *First release* is the oldest release whose dump has the bridged signature: apps built against it, up to the release before the bridge, link it. *In v0.9.2* says whether the baseline dump has it; a bridge added after the baseline turned a released signature `synthetic`, which the gate reports as a change today. *Lines* counts the JVM (android and desktop, or jvm) and klib dump lines of the bridge in the map.

## D: public data classes (8B, decision 8)

Tier A and B become plain classes in task 10 (defaults on the constructor, hand-written `copy`, `equals`, `hashCode`, `toString`, no `componentN`); tier C stays a `data class`. *Surface removed* is what the conversion takes out of the dumps: the `componentN` functions, so destructuring stops compiling. A hand-written `copy` with the same parameters keeps the `copy` signature. *Spec name* is the name in the spec 2.4 table where it differs from the declaration. *Proposed* rows are not in the spec table.

| ID | Module | Class | Tier | Reason | Surface removed | Spec name |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Regenerating

```sh
git fetch --tags
python3 tools/api-ledger.py --ref 50bd6e3   # this file and tools/api-ledger-map.tsv
python3 tools/api-compat.py --baseline-ref v0.9.2 --emit-removed \
    --ledger-map tools/api-ledger-map.tsv > tools/api-compat-allow.txt
```

The ledger is generated at this commit. Once task 9 removes the bridges the generator cannot find them any more, so later PRs keep the existing rows as they are and regenerate only the allow-list (CI checks that the committed allow-list is the generated one). A finding that regenerates as `TODO-reason` needs a new row here and its map rows in the same PR, reviewed by Ritsuko; a hand-written `copy` in task 10 must keep every default parameter, or `copy$default` disappears, which is a source break no row covers. The full procedure is in `docs/RELEASING.md`, "Ledger map after task 8".
